title: Evaluating Co-Creativity using Total Information Flow

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores with and without reversing the order of the input musical tracks (XY and YX) and calculating the Mean Squared Error (MSE) to check if the metric is affected by track position.

Computing and comparing the information flow scores on music generated by the evaluating model (MTMT) versus music generated by a different baseline model (Anticipatory Music Transformer) from the same starting context.
